title: Considering Starting An AI GameDev Thinktank
author: xThankYouFishx
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I have been coding for a long time but I have recently been hitting the AI vibe coding train. it is pretty cool and it really does help to flesh ideas and implement them.

I would gladly take the time to work with others on shared ideas and passions and be able to put our own label on the material that we can come up with but I just don't know if there are any folks like me who are passionate about this kind of thing while also willing to push the boundaries of what's possible with these agents and make games that I hope will satisfy the missing links of all the games I've ever played.

is anyone at all interested in doing something like this with me? DM me if you would like to talk about it.

comments.author: Ferreteria
comments.body: AI Game Dev needs a discord.

replies.author: xThankYouFishx
replies.body: Agreed, however for this in particular, I was thinking more intimate than a discord for all.

replies.author: Ferreteria
replies.body:
\*sigh\* 

If you insist. I'll show you mine if you show me yours ;)

comments.author: sammoga123
comments.body:
To be honest, I started developing a prototype a year ago, but this new year, with the release of Nano Banana 2 and Flow being almost "unlimited," I'll probably end up developing my story in comic format.

Making a video game is far more complex than creating comic pages or continuing the story on Wattpad.

But after all, I'm an engineer, so, idk haha

comments.author: JustAKoder
comments.body: I’d be interested too. Second the idea of having a discord. Would be awesome to really hack on this stuff with others

comments.author: cleverestx
comments.body:
I have a pretty complicated chat RPG system (local run, using LM Studio OR an API key for a cloud AI provider) that allows you to summon ANY fictional character (or a novel/invented one, you don't get to pick it, it's totallyrandomized from "infinity" and then you can create a RPG sheet for it using AI, then you load it into a chat RPG game system with AI as the game master in either open narrative mode, or a 3-act structured adventure within any genre you want with that character...It's quite ambitious and a ton of work over the last year but a blast too...I've been making good progress on it, thanks to Claude Opus 4.6 and what it can achieve....   
  
I Just shipped a web demo a few days ago (only for the summoning feature and RPG sheet PDF display layouts that it outputs), but not for the actual RPG game-play yet. I'm trying to iron that out more before I do. 

i wouldn't mind genuine community around this. So many jaded people online, it's hard to stay motivated sometimes...

replies.author: Ferreteria
replies.body: Where's your demo? We threw up a discord chat linked above if you want to come hang out and chat.

comments.author: NobodyFlowers
comments.body: I've actually created a modular world generator and am steadily working to finish the pipeline. It's going to be modular enough to link to an LLM and have them change the generator to spit out an entirely new world. Definitely need a community to share the knowledge with.
